title: Tavern Toolbox Network Remote Fetch 1.0 request
$comment: POST /v1/network/fetch with X-TTB-Protocol: 1.0; success is binary image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp,image/gif with Cache-Control: no-store, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, Content-Length, X-TTB-Request-Id. Errors use the Protocol 1.0 JSON envelope.
